Roswell Family Farm offers pasture-raised chicken and pork by the cut, so you can order exactly what your family wants without purchasing a whole animal.

👉 Swipe through the graphics to see our current cuts, prices and availability.

🌐 HOW TO ORDER

Visit RoswellFamilyFarm.com, select Chicken Orders or Pork Cuts Orders, and enter the quantities you want. Enter 0 for anything you don’t want.

We’ll review your request, confirm availability and calculate your total using the actual packaged weights. Pickup, meet-up or delivery arrangements will be confirmed directly.

A Difficult Family Update 🤍

At our recent ultrasound appointment, we received heartbreaking news about our little Walker. We learned that he has a serious condition called anencephaly, meaning his skull and brain did not develop normally. Unfortunately, he will not be able to survive.

We were informed last night that Emily will be admitted Sunday for an early delivery.

After everything that has happened over the last few days, we’ve realized that right now we need to put everything else aside and be together as a family. We hope everyone can understand why we need to step away.

For the next several days, our focus needs to be on our son and our family as we prepare for what is ahead.

We appreciate everyone’s understanding, patience, thoughts, and support during this incredibly difficult time. 🤍

— The Roswell Family
